Home Bait Al Hikmah Digital Library Library Hours Main Campus: MONDAY - FRIDAY 08:00 AM to 04:30 PM City Campus: MONDAY - FRIDAY 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM Library Borrowings Students: Max. 2 Books for 14 Days Teachers: Max. 3 Books for 30 Days Koha home Quote of the Day "Education is the foundation of every nation." ― Quaid-e-Azam Mohammad Ali Jinnah Welcome to Bait-al-Hikmah Library Digital Catalogue 🏛 History & Founding The story of Bait-al-Hikmah Library Origin Founded by Hakim Mohammed Said Shaheed , a renowned scholar, physician, and philanthropist who dedicated his life to education, health, and the promotion of Islamic heritage in Pakistan. Name Named after the legendary Bait al-Hikmah of Abbasid Baghdad — the great 8th-century "House of Wisdom" that served as the world's foremost centre of learning, translation, and scientific thought. Vision Established to preserve Pakistan's intellectual and cultural legacy while supporting modern academic research across medicine, law, Islamic studies, humanities, and social sciences. Today Now one of the largest academic libraries in Pakistan with over 250,000 volumes , fully integrated with Koha ILS, and home to irreplaceable rare manuscripts and archival collections. 📚 Collections & Heritage A treasury of knowledge across centuries and languages Rare Manuscripts 1,738 rare manuscripts in Persian, Arabic,
